.case-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0px, 1fr)); gap: 8px; }
.case-cell { min-width: 0px; }
.case-cell.full { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
.case-cell label { display: flex; min-width: 0px; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; font: 12px / 1.2 Arial, sans-serif; }

.case-cell input, .case-cell textarea, .case-cell select { display: block; min-width: 0px; width: 100%; height: 34px; box-sizing: border-box; font: inherit; color: inherit; padding: 3px 6px; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); border-width: 1px; border-style: solid; border-color: rgb(110, 120, 130); border-radius: 2px; }

.case-cell select { height: 34px; }

.actions button { font: inherit; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid rgb(80, 90, 100); border-radius: 4px; background: rgb(235, 238, 241); color: inherit; }

#textarea-explicit { font: 13px / 22px Georgia, serif; color: rgb(20, 80, 100); padding: 2px 11px 8px 6px; border-width: 2px 4px 1px 3px; border-style: solid double dotted dashed; border-color: rgb(40, 20, 100) rgb(100, 20, 40) rgb(20, 100, 40) rgb(100, 80, 20); border-radius: 12px 3px 8px 5px; background-color: rgb(238, 248, 246); width: 72%; min-width: 120px; max-width: 230px; height: 60px; min-height: 45px; max-height: 70px; box-sizing: content-box; resize: vertical; }

#select-inherit { font: inherit; color: inherit; padding: 3px 22px 5px 7px; border-width: 1px 2px 3px 4px; border-style: solid solid dashed double; border-color: rgb(35, 75, 115) rgb(115, 75, 35) rgb(35, 115, 75) rgb(75, 35, 115); border-radius: 4px 12px 6px 10px; background-color: rgb(250, 250, 244); width: 100%; height: 38px; }

#text-readonly { font: inherit; color: rgb(30, 60, 90); padding: 2px 10px 7px 4px; border-width: 1px 3px 2px 4px; border-style: solid; border-color: rgb(30, 60, 90) rgb(60, 90, 30) rgb(90, 30, 60) rgb(30, 90, 60); border-radius: 8px; background-color: rgb(235, 240, 245); }

#text-disabled { font: inherit; color: rgb(90, 35, 35); padding: 5px 4px 2px 10px; border-width: 2px 1px 3px 4px; border-style: solid dashed double solid; border-color: rgb(90, 35, 35) rgb(35, 90, 35) rgb(35, 35, 90) rgb(90, 90, 35); border-radius: 2px 8px 4px 10px; background-color: rgb(244, 235, 235); }

#width-percent { width: 72%; min-width: 120px; max-width: none; height: 36px; box-sizing: content-box; padding: 3px 8px; border: 2px solid rgb(50, 90, 130); border-radius: 6px; background-color: rgb(238, 244, 250); }

#text-content-box { width: 140px; height: 34px; min-width: 100px; max-width: 190px; box-sizing: content-box; padding: 4px 8px; border: 2px solid rgb(40, 80, 120); border-radius: 5px; background-color: rgb(240, 246, 252); }

#text-border-box { width: 140px; height: 34px; min-width: 100px; max-width: 190px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 4px 8px; border: 2px solid rgb(40, 80, 120); border-radius: 5px; background-color: rgb(240, 246, 252); }
